invariants: all public stateful operations use inherent instance methods
request target form is explicit in the RequestTarget enum
origin form requires a nonempty slash-prefixed path
absolute form validates its scheme and exact authority
authority form is accepted only for CONNECT and requires an explicit valid port
asterisk form is accepted only for OPTIONS
fragments controls whitespace userinfo malformed ports and ports above 65535 are rejected before emission
Host Content-Length Transfer-Encoding Connection and Trailer have one framing owner
head field-name field-value and field-count limits are independently bounded
the complete automatic suffix is bounded before finish mutates the writer
Content-Length is generated from explicit body length rather than inferred storage
HEAD and CONNECT response semantics are derived once from the validated method and retained without borrowing method text
HTTP 1.0 persistent requests explicitly emit keep-alive while HTTP 1.1 persistence is implicit
the request head owns only head bytes and body storage remains caller owned
finish consumes the writer and intoBytes transfers the existing head buffer without copying
